Setup

  1. Build AuroraSwitch.bin with make package (build setup).
  2. Back up a FAT32 USB drive. Put that selector BIN at the root as the only root BIN.
  3. Safely eject, insert into Aurora, then follow the ordinary stock USB update procedure.
  4. Leave AuroraSwitch.bin at the root. Create aurora/
    and put supported original firmware BINs there with their exact catalog filenames.
  5. Keep the drive connected for firmware selection and automatic boot.

Verify & launch

Hold Shift + Reverse at power-on for the menu. Keep USB connected: your last
RAM firmware choice starts automatically when its file is available. Missing or
invalid files leave the menu open.

Amber Freeze means loading. Red means loading failed; reconnect USB or check the
firmware files, then press Freeze to retry.

EchoGarden 0.3.1

Discord download

DelaysCyan

By andy on the QuBit Discord.

Multi-line echoes with diffusion/reverb around the repeats.

Knobs

Panel knob Function
1 Warp Echo spacing: tight → roughly 1× / 1.33× / 1.67× / 2×
2 Time Base echo time, about 15 ms–1.8 s
3 Blur Reverb/diffusion depth
4 Reflect Feedback, up to about 96% normally
5 Mix Dry/wet
6 Atmosphere Select 1–4 active echo lines

Buttons and gates

Control Function / active LED
8 Freeze Latch held feedback; removes new input / yellow
7 Reverse Latch ping-pong/cross-feedback / green
9 Shift, held Bloom: more reverb and a longer tail
78 Reverse / Freeze gates Temporarily invert stored button states

Details & sources

  • Knob meter: Time/Blur blue, Reflect red, Mix/Warp yellow, Atmosphere green.
  • Starting point: Time 40%, Reflect 50%, Mix 60%, one line, Blur 10%, Warp low.
  • CV scaling/ranges: not specified.

Source: author-supplied EchoGarden v0.3.1 Parameter Manual.
